note: Public sources only. The German text of Swiss federal law is authoritative (with French and Italian); the English text on Fedlex is an unofficial translation with no legal force. Where the two differ, the German passage decides; rules quote it beside the English in passage_de. Raw downloads are kept unmodified in raw/ and were parsed with python3 -I by tools/extract.py; snapshots hold only the cited articles, footnotes omitted.

consulted_not_cited.title: Swiss Civil Code (SR 210), consolidated version applicable from 2026-07-01, English and German, consulted for art. 8 (burden of proof)
consulted_not_cited.why_not_cited: Art. 8 allocates the burden of proving an alleged fact ("einer behaupteten Tatsache"). It says nothing about a fact the file does not mention, so it does not support presuming an unmentioned fact absent or present. No rule uses it, and no snapshot is stored. (A 2027-01-01 consolidation exists but is not yet applicable.)
